title: Q-SPIN-SCOPE-IMPLEMENT-TEMPLATE-GENERATOR: Implement the template-generator archetype in the spinoff Worker so the queued writers (security.txt, SPF/DMARC, privacy page) can launch
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order

Implement the template-generator archetype in the spinoff Worker so the queued writers (security.txt, SPF/DMARC, privacy page) can launch. three queued ideas with the highest impact are blocked only by this archetype; it adds no storage and no model calls. Planned cost per day: {"workers_requests": 0} against headroom {"workers_requests": 45000} (SPINOFF-IDEAS-1).

size: S
